segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Processing level of the product.

E.description: EDRs are the raw MDIS frames as returned, with the instrument's own DN values.

C.description: CDRs are single frames corrected for geometric and optical effects and converted to radiance or I/F.

D.description: DDRs carry five geometry layers per frame — latitude, longitude, incidence, emission and phase angle — derived from pixel coordinates and SPICE.

segments.label: Camera
segments.description: Which of MDIS's two co-aligned cameras took the frame.

segments.label: Clock partition
segments.description: Spacecraft clock partition minus one, so it distinguishes frames taken before and after the clock reset.

values.0: Spacecraft clock partition 1 — before the clock reset
values.1: Spacecraft clock partition 2 — after the clock reset

segments.label: Mission Elapsed Time
segments.description: Spacecraft clock seconds counter from the image header, taken at the end of the exposure.

patterns.meaning: Mission Elapsed Time {1} seconds, at the last second of the exposure

segments.label: Filter
segments.description: WAC filter wheel position; the NAC has no wheel and always reads "M".

values.M: Narrow Angle Camera, which has no filter wheel

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: Product format.

values.IMG: PDS image with an attached label

segments.description: Mercury Dual Imaging System (MDIS).

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Which mosaic the tile belongs to.

BDR.description: Monochrome basemap imaging mosaicked into non-overlapping tiles, one per quadrant of a Mercury chart.

MDR.description: MDIS eight-colour imaging mosaicked into 54 non-overlapping tiles.

segments.label: Resolution
segments.description: Map resolution of the tile.

segments.label: Mercury chart
segments.description: The pre-existing Mercury chart the tile is cut from.

segments.label: Quadrant
segments.description: Which part of the chart the tile spans.
